officialProfile.title: Athlifyr
officialProfile.description: Athlifyr is a platform that connects athletes, helps discover sporting events, and builds communities around outdoor sports and physical activities.

events.title: Events
events.description: Discover trail running, cycling, triathlon events and much more. Mark your participation and see who's going!

community.title: Community
community.description: Connect with other athletes, share experiences, and find training partners.

venues.title: Venues
venues.description: Find gyms, studios, and training spaces near you with class schedules and booking.

success.title: Email verified!
success.description: Your email has been verified successfully. You can now enable email notifications.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.description: The verification link has expired. Request a new link in your account settings.

error.title: Verification error
error.invalidToken: The verification link is invalid or has already been used.
error.serverError: A server error occurred. Please try again later.
